branding.heroKicker: Patriots archive - AFL roots, dynasty scale, and Foxborough winters
branding.heroText: This site is a fan-built database documenting every New England Patriots game from 1960 through 2025. Boston AFL origins, Parcells breakthroughs, Brady-Belichick dynasties, and every Foxborough era shift in one archive.

franchiseSummary.intro: This site is a fan-built database documenting every New England Patriots game from 1960 through 2025. Boston AFL origins, Parcells breakthroughs, Brady-Belichick dynasties, and every Foxborough era shift in one archive.
franchiseSummary.legacySummary: The Patriots moved from AFL instability to one of the most dominant dynasties in North American sports, anchored by elite coaching, quarterback play, and situational excellence.

notableEras.label: AFL Origins
notableEras.description: Boston and early Foxborough seasons built the roots of the franchise before sustained NFL relevance arrived.

notableEras.label: Parcells Revival
notableEras.description: Bill Parcells restored credibility and carried the Patriots back into contender status.

notableEras.label: Brady-Belichick Dynasty
notableEras.description: Six Super Bowls, constant division control, and one of the greatest dynastic runs in sports history.

notableEras.label: Post-Dynasty Reset
notableEras.description: The modern Patriots are reshaping their identity after the Brady era while staying anchored in franchise history.

sources.note: Official 2026 schedule is live. 15 of 17 games have published date and kickoff windows, while 2 flex or TBD slots will keep updating as ESPN finalizes them.
